items.title: Match Report: Victory
items.body: We beat {opponent} {score} in Round {round}. {scorer} did the business. Three points in the bag.

items.title: Three Points Secured
items.body: {opponent} came to play. We played better. {score} — and {scorer} takes the headlines.

items.title: Job Done
items.body: A professional {score} win over {opponent}. The coaches will talk about {scorer}'s finish for a week.

items.title: Winning Feels Good
items.body: Round {round}: {opponent} beaten {score}. Someone has put a drawing of {scorer}'s goal on the fridge.

items.title: The Board Is Pleased
items.body: The board watched the {score} win over {opponent} and nodded slowly. That is board language for delighted.

items.title: Fan Mail Received
items.body: A young fan sent a drawing of {scorer} scoring against {opponent}. The likeness is questionable. The joy is real.

items.title: Match Report: Defeat
items.body: Lost {score} to {opponent} in Round {round}. It stings. Next match, we go again.

items.title: A Quiet Bus Ride
items.body: {opponent} beat us {score}. The bus ride home was quiet. Training tomorrow will not be.

items.title: Lessons Learned
items.body: {score} against {opponent}. {scorer} kept fighting to the very end. That is the bit to keep.

items.title: Chin Up, Boss
items.body: The kit man says every great manager loses one like this. {score} to {opponent}. He also lost the cones.

items.title: We Go Again
items.body: Round {round} did not go our way. {opponent}, {score}. The table forgets fast. So should we.

items.title: Match Report: Draw
items.body: {score} against {opponent} in Round {round}. One point each. Nobody sings about a draw. Nobody cries either.

items.title: Honours Even
items.body: A {score} draw with {opponent}. {scorer} scored ours. The handshakes were extremely polite.

items.title: A Point Shared
items.body: {opponent} held us to {score}. The analysts call it a chess match. The chess club disagrees.

items.title: So Close
items.body: So close against {opponent}. {score} it finished. One more pass and this is a different inbox.

items.title: Match Report: Statement Win
items.body: {score}! {opponent} could not live with us. {scorer} was unplayable. Frame this one.

items.title: Goals, Goals, Goals
items.body: We hit {opponent} for plenty — {score} in Round {round}. The scoreboard operator has asked for a rest.

items.title: Total Football
items.body: A {score} demolition of {opponent}. {scorer} ran the whole show. The highlight reel is very long.

items.title: That Was Loud
items.body: {score} over {opponent}. The fans lost their voices in Round {round}. Worth it, they say.

items.title: Giant Toppled
items.body: Nobody gave us a chance against {opponent}. Final score: {score}. Cut out the newspaper. Keep it forever.

items.title: Shock of the Season
items.body: {opponent} arrived as favourites. They left beaten, {score}. {scorer} wrote the story.

items.title: Believe It
items.body: Round {round}, and it actually happened. {opponent} beaten, {score}. The dressing room is still bouncing.

items.title: Not On Paper
items.body: On paper, {opponent} win easily. Football is not played on paper. {score}.

items.title: Clean Sheet Secured
items.body: Not one goal past us against {opponent}. The keeper wants the match ball. The defenders want it too.

items.title: The Wall Held
items.body: {opponent} tried everything. Nothing went in. {score}, and the back line walked off grinning.

items.title: Zero Is Beautiful
items.body: A clean sheet in Round {round}. The goalkeeping coach has printed the stat and laminated it.

items.title: Nothing Got Through
items.body: {opponent} huffed and puffed. Our goal stayed shut. Free hot chocolate for the defenders on the bus.

items.title: Next Up: {opponent}
items.body: Round {round} brings {opponent} to town. Their manager has been talking. Let the football answer.

items.title: Scout Report: {opponent}
items.body: The scouts watched {opponent} twice. Verdict: dangerous, but beatable. Set the tactics well, boss.

items.title: Big Match Ahead
items.body: Everyone is talking about Round {round}: us against {opponent}. Tickets went fast. Nerves are normal.

items.title: The Papers Are Talking
items.body: The local paper calls {opponent} favourites. The squad pinned the article to the wall. Motivation sorted.

items.title: Match Day Approaches
items.body: {opponent} in Round {round}. The kit is washed. The boots are polished. The plan is yours, boss.

items.title: Climbing the Table
items.body: The results are in. We move up to {position}. Keep winning and keep climbing.

items.title: League Table Update
items.body: We now sit {position} in the league. The board checked the table twice. Then smiled.

items.title: A Slip in the Standings
items.body: The table says {position}. It reads worse than it feels. One win changes everything.

items.title: Eyes on the Prize
items.body: {position} after Round {round}. The gap at the top is shrinking. So is the excuse list.

items.title: A New Season Begins
items.body: Fresh grass, fresh hopes, zero points for everyone. A whole season ahead. Make it count, boss.

items.title: Halfway There
items.body: Round {round} complete — half the season gone. We sit {position}. The second half decides everything.

items.title: The Run-In Begins
items.body: Only a few rounds left. We stand {position}. Every match is a final now.

items.title: Club Milestone Reached
items.body: The club marks a milestone this week. The trophy cabinet has been dusted. Just in case.
